prompt: Photorealistic side-view product rendering of a compact wheeled drum excavator rover on a loose dark gray granular soil bed, front at left, rear at right. Low rectangular aluminum chassis on four large knee-high steel spiked grouser wheels, two visible in profile. Transverse steel digging drum low at the front edge touching a loose pile. Tall slender folding perception mast vertical at front of chassis, about person-height when extended, with small camera head on top. Central sheet-steel hopper now raised high at rear on twin inclined arms of rear lift mast, tipped forward pouring a visible stream of granular soil into an open steel collection bin behind the rover. Daylight product-shot lighting, real metals, dusty field test context. Show load path readable from hopper through lift arms into chassis to wheels. Draw short clean callouts on small light tags in empty space with thin leader lines for each: Rear Lift Mast, High Lift Hopper, Chassis Frame, Front Digging Drum, Spiked Grouser Wheel, Folding Perception Mast, no other text, no margins, no scale bars.
must_not: hoppers hidden inside body or missing pour stream
sketch style lines and flat color blocks
changes_from_previous: First rendering from mechanism sketches, no prior image to revise.

visual_plan.view: side elevation with slight three-quarter depth to show wheel width and bin, mechanism fully readable
visual_plan.spatial_layout: True side elevation, eye-level, front of rover left, rear right. Foreground soil bed, background open yard. Left to right: dig pile and drum, front wheel, chassis box, perception mast rising above, rear wheel, raised mast arms leaning back, tipped hopper overhanging steel bin at far right.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Deployed working moment with rear hopper fully raised and tipped dumping granular regolith into collection bin while front drum is engaged with dig pile and tall mast is erect for remote driving.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Load: hopper soil weight down into rear lift mast arms into chassis frame down into grouser wheels to ground; Signal: camera head on perception mast down to onboard box for remote link.
visual_plan.interactions: Front drum contacts soil pile to scoop; chassis sits on four grouser wheels; hopper bottom rides in rear lift mast guides and is tipped by linkage; perception mast fixed upright at front carrying camera head; falling soil stream connects hopper lip to bin pile.

focus_parts.purpose: raises hopper to high pour position
carries soil and tips to dump
holds cameras high for remote view
